settings-popup-component.rules-configured-description: Manage saved rules below. The first enabled rule matching the site and path takes priority.
settings-popup-component.rules-empty: No rules configured yet. Choose Set up new rule to add one.
settings-popup-component.rules-new-description: Replace the example below with one rule for your site. Use a unique ID, exact website origin, and CSS selectors for the fields. Adding a rule appends it after your configured rules without replacing them.
settings-popup-component.rules-description: Edit CSS selector rules for sites that generic autofill cannot classify. Load a JSON file or edit below, then import to save. Import replaces the rule list; export your existing rules first if you want to keep them.
settings-popup-component.rules-security-answers: Security-answer mappings pair an answerSelector with a questionSelector. The displayed question matches a custom-field name in Strongbox. Answers fill only when you request AutoFill. Rules contain selectors, never saved answers. The first rule matching the origin and path takes priority.
settings-popup-component.open-error: Unable to open the settings page.

settings-page.general-description: Choose how SBX Autofill appears and behaves in your browser.
settings-page.autofill-description: Control automatic filling and the sites where it is allowed.
settings-page.inline-description: Choose when the in-page menu appears and what it shows.
settings-page.appearance-description: Adjust the popup and inline menu. Settings appearance follows your system.
settings-page.rules-description: Configure site-specific rules to identify the right fields on a page.
settings-page.disclaimer: SBX Autofill is an independent browser extension. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Phoebe Code Limited or Strongbox.
settings-page.language-help: Use your browser language or choose one below.
settings-page.system-theme-help: This page switches between light and dark when your system changes.
settings-page.saved-automatically: Preferences are saved automatically. Site rules are saved separately when you choose Add rule or Save changes.
settings-page.local-rules-help: Use Site rules when a website needs custom field selectors. Rules apply only to the origins and paths you configure.
settings-page.rule-priority: The first enabled rule matching the site and path takes priority.
settings-page.no-rules: No rules yet. Add a rule for a site that needs custom field mapping.
settings-page.bulk-help: Saving this document replaces all configured rules. Download a backup before making bulk changes.
settings-page.scope-description: Define which site and pages this rule applies to.
settings-page.mapping-description: Tell SBX Autofill which fields to use on the page.
settings-page.disable-heuristics: Use only these mappings on matching pages
settings-page.security-help: Map the displayed question to its answer field. The question must match a custom-field name in Strongbox. Do not enter answers here.
settings-page.preserve-order: This rule keeps its place in the configured list.
settings-page.append-note: Added after your existing rules. Existing rules stay unchanged.
settings-page.about-rule-description: A rule identifies the fields to fill on the sites and paths you specify.
settings-page.enter-origin: Enter a website origin to define where this rule applies.
settings-page.preview-description: The configuration that will be validated and saved.
settings-page.selector-help: Prefer a stable, unique field ID. A selector that matches several fields may prevent autofill. Rules store selectors, never credentials.
settings-page.replace-warning: This replaces the entire configured list with the JSON document. Have you downloaded a backup?
